summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice to the Market dated October 2, 2026, announcing a second oil-bearing interval in the Morpho well (1-BRSA-1405-APS) in block FZA-M-59, ultra-deep waters off Amapa, Brazil, at 2,886 meters water depth. The find follows the August 14, 2026 discovery and reflects deeper-interval evaluation via electrical logs, rock and fluid samples. No deal terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock are stated; this is an operational exploration update, not a special situation, with reserve characterization and lab analysis still pending.
